sentences.text: Heard on IA No.7119 of 2023, which is an application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C. on behalf of the appellant-Dashrath for grant of bail and suspension of remaining jail sentence.

Appellant has been convicted for the offence under Section 363, 366, 376(2)(n) of IPC and Section 5L/6 of POCSO Act and sentenced to 10 years R.I. with fine of Rs.1,000/- (two counts), with usual default stipulation.

Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant has solemnized marriage with the prosecutrix on 21.4.2021 as per their customary rituals and rites and prosecutrix is his legally married wife and they are blessed with a male child on 9.4.2022.
Now prosecutrix is living with the mother of the appellant, but no male member is available to look after the prosecutrix and her minor child.
Hence she prays for grant of bail and suspension of remaining jail sentence of the appellant.
Per contra, learned PL for the respondent/State opposes the application for suspension of sentence and prays for its rejection.
Counsel for the prosecutrix submits that the prosecutrix has no objection if the appellant is enlarged on bail and his remaining jail sentence is suspended.
She has filed affidavit of the prosecutrix and her father Jitendra as well as the affidavit of appellant's mother Rami Bai.
Considered the facts and circumstances of the case and submissions made by learned counsel for the parties.
The factum of marriage of the appellant with the prosecutrix is supported by the marriage certificate, photographs, affidavit of the prosecutrix and her father.
In the Adhar Card of the prosecutrix, name of the appellant is shown as husband of the prosecutrix.

sentences.text: Looking to the aforesaid documents and affidavits, it is established that the appellant has solemnized marriage with the prosecutrix and they have been blessed with a child.

In view of the above, without commenting upon merits of the case, IA No.7119 of 2023 is allowed and the execution of remaining jail sentence of the appellant-Dashrath is hereby suspended till the final disposal of this appeal and it is ordered that the appellant be released on bail on his depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited, and upon furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.75,000/- with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, with a further direction to appear before the Registry of this Court on 21.12.2023 and on such other dates,
as may be fixed by the Registry of this Court in this regard during the pendency of this appeal.
C.C. as per rules.
